title: Graphs of group actions and group actions on trees
summary: Bass-Serre theory provides a powerful framework for studying group actions on trees. While extremely effective for structural questions in group theory, it is less suited to the systematic construction of group actions with prescribed local behaviour. Motivated by local-to-global constructions such as the Burger-Mozes universal groups and local action diagrams, we develop an analogue of Bass-Serre theory for group actions.
